tagline: Finds people talking about your product, ranked by buying intent

source.excerpt: Shared as a cross-forum listening tool that scores mentions by intent.

body:
## What it does

It sweeps four public forums - Hacker News, Reddit, Bluesky and X - for anyone naming your product, naming a rival, or otherwise sounding like they are close to buying something. Fresh hits arrive already sorted, so the conversations most likely to become a customer sit at the top. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @tarasshyn shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
